column1: # tools/i18n/glossary-context.tsv: the glossary's context rows (R3-UI, round-3 lock-in; tools/i18n/check.py). At the
# places a row names, its en phrase replaces the glossary.tsv rendering of the same nl phrase (or of the shorter
# phrase a longer nl phrase here contains): a second rendering that is right there. check.py fails on a row whose nl
# phrase no checked text at its places has any more (stale), and on a place it does not visit (only vendor/ui/js and
# the host's JSON tables; check_pairs.py keeps its own GLOSSARY_OK, check_rust.py its own rules).
# Columns (tab-separated): where, nl phrase, en phrase, flags, why.
#   where: comma-separated places <file below the repo>:<key glob> (fnmatch; the file may be a glob). The key is a
#     makeT key (a plural's base key), P(<page id>).title|description for a settings-registry page, "pair" for an
#     inline {nl, en} pair, or the key of a host JSON table.
#   flags: "-", "name" (case-sensitive, as in glossary.tsv), "known" (an accepted deviation, not a right rendering:
#     the report names it, its owner fixes it).
# Windows Update: "Retry" as on Windows 11's Update page (D-G41); "Try again" everywhere else (glossary.tsv)
